ambient: 雾又浓了一层，栈桥那头的灯影只剩一个晕。
一只夜鹭在栈桥上叫了两声，又没了动静。
值班室的电台沙沙响了几下，没有呼叫。
远处浮标的铃铛被浪推着，断断续续地响。
comment: Scenario C5 (V0.2-C blind test, written by an independent tester from the data contract only): a lighthouse on a rocky point at the start of fog season. The keeper privately knows from the radio log that a fishing boat will pass the reef tonight and needs light plus fog horn; the mechanic privately knows the fog horn's compressor belt snapped at dusk and that the spare belt is in the base storage cabinet; the boat hand privately knows the jetty signal lamp is out. The mechanic's repair goal only activates once he learns a ship is coming; the keeper's readiness goal only completes once he learns from the mechanic that the horn can be restored. Location graph is a path of four (boathouse-jetty-base-lamp_room) — not isomorphic to the tavern/warehouse tree or the clinic ring-plus-leaf. Modeling convention (same latitude as the clinic's 'acquire the spare box = restocked'): the belt is the horn's only fault, so the spare belt in the mechanic's hands is first-hand proof the horn can be restored — spare_belt's reveals carry fog_horn_ready at 0.95.

belt_report: {name}：雾笛的皮带傍晚就断了，我正想办法，备件在值班室柜子里。
{name}：跟你说一声——雾笛现在响不了，皮带断了，我去取备件。
speech_lines.horn_inquire: {name}：雾笛那边，到底能不能响了？我这边等着确认。
horn_report: {name}：雾笛能修好——备件皮带已经到手，我这就装回去。
{name}：放心，雾笛误不了事，备件拿到了。
lamp_report: {name}：栈桥那盏信号灯傍晚就灭了，我亲眼看见的。
{name}：跟你们说一声，栈桥信号灯不亮了。
speech_lines.ship_inquire: {name}：今晚真有船要贴着礁石回港？消息准吗？
ship_notice: {name}：电台刚记下——今晚有渔船贴着暗礁回港，得靠咱的灯和雾笛。
{name}：跟你说一声，后半夜有船回来，雾又大，各处都得备好。
smalltalk: {name}：这雾起得邪乎，怕是要封一夜海。
